facts.text: Before European colonization, Central Garage lay within the traditional territory of the Pamunkey and Mattaponi tribes, Algonquian peoples of the Powhatan Confederacy.
Central Garage prides itself on fostering a close-knit community, hosting events from farmers' markets to local fairs that celebrate the area's rich history and culture.
One of Central Garage's true treasures is its scenic beauty, drawing visitors to picturesque vistas and historic landmarks.
Outdoor enthusiasts in Central Garage find abundant green spaces and scenic trails perfect for leisurely walks or invigorating runs.
Central Garage thrives with local businesses that add flavor and character to everyday life, from fresh produce to unique crafts.
This charming town exudes a warm and inviting atmosphere, where neighbors greet each other with friendly waves and smiles.
